craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of rested-emitted — peace inside wonder; rest-and-publish song. Triple-drawn time; she-draws-herself (feminine agent kept); time-drawer close. Rejected: (a) neuter it → killed: she is the drawer. Read aloud: TRI-ple-COURSED … GLOR-i-ous SU-preme TIME-draw-ER.

lines: she draws herself, outside — then in self — glorious supreme time-drawer.
l4.sanskrit_cite: trivahaṃ tripathaṃ tristhaṃ kālaṃ sā karṣati svataḥ bahis tataś cātmanīti śrīparā kālakarṣiṇī

reads_against.argmap: What time draws itself? → Triple time self-drawn outside, self-drawn within.
c1_essence: Triple time self-drawn out and in.
